traceAs.steps/failure.cjs: Inside the calling step's own record (setup, probes): one coded event under the caller's step name.
traceAs.steps/release.cjs: Inside doctor's probes record: one probe row, release files, measured, failed with the file named, or not measured.
traceAs.steps/said.cjs: Inside the hook port's hook.out record (adapters/hook): its n counts the items, the texts said and the short forms; its rows are the file .atlasbound/cli/said/<session>.jsonl.
traceAs.steps/modules.cjs: Modules and modulesSet are the cli's `modules` record (argv's table); modulesChosen refuses before any record, so a refused choice writes nothing; offOf works inside the hook port's hook.out record.
traceAs.steps/person.cjs: Inside the cli.verb record's place: a refusal is one coded event (person-only) under cli.verb, written before the verb's own record.
